title: Patch: Paranoia's set Spells resolve when set and again when revealed
notes: Meditative #99 Paranoia: a Spell its controller sets face-down while it acts resolves as it is set, its choices prompted, and again as it reveals (R3806000); Radiant Paranoia's Echo only at the reveal. A card played face-down as a Trap no longer runs its Cry at the set (the engine had run a set card's Cry, or a set Spell's text, when it needed no choice), which is why the shipped cards set by a Buff's Cloaked in classify's games play differently; catalog check rejects a Trap or Field Trap face that prints Cry:. Stinkyscape+ #31 Soul Read's pick, the one Trap face that printed Cry:, is worded "When played face down:" and plays as before.

player.title: Paranoia resolves set Spells twice
changes: Paranoia: a Spell you set face-down while it is out resolves as you set it, choosing its targets then, and again when you reveal it.
A Spell set under Paranoia stays face-down in between, and your opponent never sees which Spell it was.
text: Soul Read says "When played face down:" where it said "Cry:", on both faces. It plays as before.
fixes: A card set face-down by Cloaked no longer runs its Cry, or a Spell's effect, as it is set: it waits for the reveal, unless Paranoia resolves the Spell as it is set.
